result.title: Scalable Unrolled Chains for MRI Reconstruction
result.comment: 23 pages (including supplementary material), 14 figures. Accepted at WACV 2027
result.summary: Unrolled variational networks achieve state-of-the-art performance for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but standard end-to-end training becomes prohibitively memory intensive as the number and width of cascades increase. We propose a memory-efficient training framework that updates a randomly sampled cascade while retaining supervision from the final reconstruction loss. The error signal is propagated from the end of the chain to the sampled cascade using an activation-light backward pass that avoids storing full chain activations, thereby decoupling training memory from chain length. A time-conditioned network shared across cascades further keeps the parameter count independent of chain length. The backward pass is approximate only through frozen normalization statistics, and a trained exact gradient control shows the approximation leaves reconstruction quality unchanged. The framework remains trainable at chain lengths and cascade widths where standard end-to-end backpropagation exhausts GPU memory. On fastMRI single-coil knee and multi-coil brain reconstruction, our method consistently outperforms other local training approaches. On high-SNR knee slices, our method surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and matches it at $4\times$, while on the complete brain validation set it surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and achieves comparable performance at $4\times$, with fewer parameters, lower peak memory, and faster per-iteration training. Code is available at https://github.com/emehillaj/scalable-unrolled-mri.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向加速 MRI 重建的展开式变分网络，提出随机采样单个 cascade 并仍从最终重建损失回传梯度的省显存训练框架，配合不存储整链激活的轻量反向传播与跨 cascade 共享的时间条件网络，使训练显存与参数量不随链长增长。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「长迭代链 + 时间条件共享参数 + 局部采样监督仍用终局损失」的做法，可能为 VLM 循环式 latent 推理的链长扩展、贡献分配与训练成本提供可核查线索，但本身不涉及视觉推理或 latent 状态分析。
